title: Mike and Friends
statementMd:
What-The-Fatherland is a strange country! All phone numbers there are strings consisting of lowercase English letters. What is double strange that a phone number can be associated with several bears!

In that country there is a rock band called CF consisting of $*n*$ bears (including Mike) numbered from $1$ to $*n*$.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a17717892c007192f75d632aec03b32cb0272c04.png)

Phone number of $*i*$-th member of CF is $*s*_{*i*}$. May 17th is a holiday named Phone Calls day. In the last Phone Calls day, everyone called all the numbers that are substrings of his/her number (one may call some number several times). In particular, everyone called himself (that was really strange country).

Denote as $*call*(*i*, *j*)$ the number of times that $*i*$-th member of CF called the $*j*$-th member of CF.

The geek Mike has $*q*$ questions that he wants to ask you. In each question he gives you numbers $*l*, *r*$ and $*k*$ and you should tell him the number

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5d88aa17404a169820d99e54b01b8ac2a9552067.png)

## Input

The first line of input contains integers $*n*$ and $*q*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 2 × 10^{5}$ and $1 ≤ *q* ≤ 5 × 10^{5}$).

The next $*n*$ lines contain the phone numbers, $*i*$-th line contains a string $*s*_{*i*}$ consisting of lowercase English letters (![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b60bbd11dae7b5f43c55918a57e5e68833b6b60a.png)).

The next $*q*$ lines contain the information about the questions, each of them contains integers $*l*, *r*$ and $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *l* ≤ *r* ≤ *n*$ and $1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n*$).

## Output

Print the answer for each question in a separate line.
statementZhMd:
What-The-Fatherland 是一个奇怪的国家！那里所有的电话号码都是由小写英文字母组成的字符串。更奇怪的是，一个电话号码可能对应好几只熊！

在这个国家有一支名为 CF 的摇滚乐队，由 $*n*$ 只熊组成（包括 Mike），编号从 $1$ 到 $*n*$。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/a17717892c007192f75d632aec03b32cb0272c04.png)

CF 第 $*i*$ 位成员的电话号码是 $*s*_{*i*}$。5 月 17 日是名为“电话日”的节日。在上一个电话日，每个人都拨打了所有作为自己电话号码子串的号码（某个号码可能会被拨打多次）。特别地，每个人都拨打了自己的号码（这在那个奇怪的国家里确实很正常）。

记 $*call*(*i*, *j*)$ 为 CF 第 $*i*$ 位成员拨打第 $*j*$ 位成员的次数。

宅男 Mike 有 $*q*$ 个问题要问你。每个问题会给出 $*l*$、$*r*$ 和 $*k*$，你需要告诉他以下数值：

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5d88aa174a169820d99e54b01b8ac2a9552067.png)

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*q*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 2 × 10^{5}$，$1 ≤ *q* ≤ 5 × 10^{5}$）。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行包含电话号码，第 $*i*$ 行包含一个由小写英文字母组成的字符串 $*s*_{*i*}$（![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b60bbd11dae7b5f43c55918a57e5e68833b6b60a.png)）。

接下来的 $*q*$ 行包含问题的信息，每行包含三个整数 $*l*$、$*r*$ 和 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *l* ≤ *r* ≤ *n*$，$1 ≤ *k* ≤ *n*$）。

## 输出格式

对于每个问题，单独一行输出答案。
